outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit stay 48 hours or longer
Spontaneous preterm delivery before 32 weeks of gestation
cohort: 226,958 singleton pregnancies in British Columbia (Canada) from 2004 to 2012
finding: A 10% difference in prepregnancy BMI was associated with at least a 10% lower risk of several adverse pregnancy outcomes, including preeclampsia, gestational diabetes, and stillbirth, while larger differences were needed to impact outcomes like cesarean delivery.
